data: You fake a creature out with superficial tears, lowering their defenses. When activating this move, a target must make a {save}. On a failure, all attack rolls against the target are given a +5 bonus until the end of your next turn.
Makes the audience quickly grow bored when an appeal move has little effect.
Moves that get 2 Appeal points or less do not increase the crowd meter until the end of your next turn.
